name: mobile-view
description: Reads like the Claude mobile app: one line per tool call, long code blocks folded, your prompts numbered, and a Questions view (. in an empty prompt, Esc to go back) that jumps back to any earlier prompt. /mobile-view off returns to stock rendering.

codeLines.title: Fold code blocks longer than
codeLines.description: Code blocks in Claude's replies with more lines than this are folded to one line; a button under the reply shows them.

maxGroupLines.title: Calls listed per group
maxGroupLines.description: How many calls of a run of reads, searches and shell commands get their own line before the rest is counted.
